skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concept of strategic human resource management, the role of human resources in organizational strategy, and the relationship between HR practices and organizational goals.
Evaluate the effectiveness of HR strategies and their contribution to organizational strategy.
Demonstrate effective teamwork and independent work skills.
Present reports and discuss HR strategies effectively.
Analyze and synthesize information related to HR strategies.
Solve problems related to HR strategies in specific organizations.
Understand and apply strategic approaches to recruitment and selection.
Understand and apply strategic approaches to employee relations.
Understand and apply strategic approaches to compensation management.
Understand and apply strategic approaches to training and development.
Understand and apply strategic approaches to performance management.
